bottleneck.summary: ScRu2→ScTc2 has +.1228…+.4320 lambda and sourceTc+1.175 K, path0, force0 and stress .290 GPa. Hf/Zr/Lu/ternary neighbors usually beat target and stay visible. Tc radioactivity and C14/C15 competition bound the sourceC15 local candidate.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.001 GPa; fine force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure -0.29 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

proposed_contribution.next_action: Resolve exact priorphase and saved ScRu2/Tc2 mode differences. Favorable: distinct C15 local phase with preserved controlled response; adverse: exact alias benchmark or phase conversion; ambiguous: prior structure incomplete.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
